context:
Goal: the Orphaned composer passes the contrast audit.
Problem (rule): the audit flags Save envelope and the 1 card count, but both colours already clear the floor (12.17:1 and 5.24:1); the likely cause is placement, since adding a card drops the Save row 62 pt under the keyboard with no re-scroll, and the fix re-scrolls the input after a suggestion tap while your rule says nothing moves under your finger, so only you can allow it.
Based on (measured): the two colour pairs, 12.17:1 and 5.24:1, from the colour tokens.
Based on (read): the designer's mockup at the folded Duo size, 466 by 678 pt: keep the colours and add a margin so the Save row sits 56 pt above the keyboard top, re-scrolled on each height change (branch design-orphaned-contrast, docs/design/orphaned-composer-contrast.html).
Unmeasured: the 44 pt strip on the folded Duo and the 12 pt clearance.
Departs from: main has no re-scroll on the composer — option a adds one.
Waiting on: your answer; both Save and the count stay red under the existing debt meanwhile.

options.gain: The audit passes with no skip.
options.how: The Save row sits 56 pt above the keyboard top and is re-scrolled when the keyboard height changes.
options.label: Build the margin as drawn
options.lose: The input can move once after you tap a suggestion.

options.how: The audit skips the contrast check on Save envelope.
options.label: Keep today's layout and skip the audit on the Save frame

short: Orphaned composer: add a margin or skip Save

title: Should the Orphaned composer get a margin above the keyboard so the audit passes?
why: It fixes the cause with no skip, at the cost of one possible move after a suggestion tap (coordinator's recommendation).
